title: UNS · Enterprise overview (MariaDB)
description: Top of the ISA-95 model: sites, areas and their communication health.

list.name: enterprise
list.label: Enterprise
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.enterprise FROM uns.points p WHERE TRUE ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT p.enterprise FROM uns.points p WHERE TRUE ORDER BY 1

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.site FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT p.site FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Size of the selected part of the ISA-95 equipment model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.site) AS `Sites`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.site, p.area) AS `Areas`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.site, p.area, p.line, p.device) AS `Devices`, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.enabled THEN 1 END) AS `Points` FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)

panels.title: Communication
panels.description: Share of enabled points that reported within the stale window, and the share of non-good OPC quality samples in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state = 'ok' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state <> 'disabled' THEN 1 END), 0), 1) AS DOUBLE) AS `Reporting`, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state = 'stale' THEN 1 END) AS `Stale`, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state = 'never' THEN 1 END) AS `Never seen`, (SELECT CAST(ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN r.quality & 192 <> 192 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS DOUBLE) FROM uns.readings r WHERE r.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) AND $__timeFilter(r.time)) AS `Bad quality` FROM (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN NOT s.enabled THEN 'disabled' WHEN s.last_seen IS NULL THEN 'never' WHEN s.age_s > ${stale} THEN 'stale' ELSE 'ok' END AS state FROM uns.point_status s) p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)

panels.title: Equipment hierarchy
panels.description: Enterprise > site > area > line > device. Node is green when the node's newest sample is younger than the stale window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.path AS id, MAX(h.name) AS title, CONCAT(MAX(h.level), ' · ', COUNT(*), ' points') AS subtitle, CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' pts') AS mainstat, MAX(h.level) AS `detail__Level`, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(h.last_seen), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS `detail__Last seen`, CASE WHEN MAX(h.last_seen) > UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL ${stale} SECOND THEN 'rgb(115, 191, 105)' ELSE 'rgb(242, 73, 92)' END AS color FROM uns.hierarchy_points h WHERE h.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) GROUP BY h.path

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(h.parent_path, '->', h.path) AS id, h.parent_path AS source, h.path AS target FROM uns.hierarchy_points h WHERE h.parent_path IS NOT NULL AND h.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site))

panels.title: Areas
panels.description: Click an area to open it in the Equipment dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.enterprise, p.site, p.area, COUNT(DISTINCT p.device) AS devices, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state = 'ok' THEN 1 END) AS ok, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.state IN ('stale', 'never') THEN 1 END) AS problems, MIN(p.age_s) AS last_seen FROM (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN NOT s.enabled THEN 'disabled' WHEN s.last_seen IS NULL THEN 'never' WHEN s.age_s > ${stale} THEN 'stale' ELSE 'ok' END AS state FROM uns.point_status s) p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Samples by site
panels.description: Stored samples per time bucket: a drop means a site stopped publishing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.time, p.site AS metric, CAST(SUM(t.samples) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM ( SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(r.time) / GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 1)) * GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 1)) AS time, r.point_id, AVG(r.value) AS avg, MIN(r.value) AS min, MAX(r.value) AS max, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM uns.readings r WHERE NOT ($__interval_ms >= 3600000 OR $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() >= 604800) AND r.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) AND $__timeFilter(r.time) GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(h.time) / GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 3600)) * GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 3600)), h.point_id, SUM(h.avg * h.samples) / NULLIF(SUM(h.samples), 0), MIN(h.min), MAX(h.max), CAST(SUM(h.samples) AS INTEGER) FROM uns.readings_1h h WHERE ($__interval_ms >= 3600000 OR $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() >= 604800) AND h.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) AND h.time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR($__unixEpochFrom() / 3600) * 3600) AND h.time < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2) t JOIN uns.points p USING (point_id) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Reporting points by site
panels.description: Distinct points with at least one sample per bucket.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.time, p.site AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT t.point_id) AS value FROM ( SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(r.time) / GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 1)) * GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 1)) AS time, r.point_id, AVG(r.value) AS avg, MIN(r.value) AS min, MAX(r.value) AS max, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM uns.readings r WHERE NOT ($__interval_ms >= 3600000 OR $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() >= 604800) AND r.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) AND $__timeFilter(r.time) GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(h.time) / GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 3600)) * GREATEST(FLOOR($__interval_ms / 1000), 3600)), h.point_id, SUM(h.avg * h.samples) / NULLIF(SUM(h.samples), 0), MIN(h.min), MAX(h.max), CAST(SUM(h.samples) AS INTEGER) FROM uns.readings_1h h WHERE ($__interval_ms >= 3600000 OR $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() >= 604800) AND h.point_id IN (SELECT p.point_id FROM uns.points p WHERE p.enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND p.site IN ($site)) AND h.time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR($__unixEpochFrom() / 3600) * 3600) AND h.time < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2) t JOIN uns.points p USING (point_id) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
